sentences.text: For an electrical fire, kill the power at the battery switch or breaker first, then use carbon dioxide or dry chemical.
For a grease fire on a galley stove, smother it with a lid or a fire blanket and turn off the heat.
Never use water, which makes burning grease explode outward.
Propane is heavier than air, so a leak sinks into the bilge just like gasoline vapor.
Close the valve at the tank, and if you smell propane, ventilate thoroughly before any spark.
A fire blanket is also the fastest way to smother burning clothing.
